05 / Selected work

Projects

Flagship project / Device ownership

Titan Verification Center

Visit Titan ↗

Titan gives phone buyers a way to check the handset and its registered owner before money changes hands. The same ownership record supports agent-assisted registration, incident reports, and transfers.

My engineering role

I work on the system architecture, database design, and verification workflows that connect the public phone check with registered ownership records, agent operations, and administrative auditing.

Public lookup and owner privacy

Titan separates the device lookup from the ownership check. Buyers can compare available IMEI information with the handset. A matching owner code is required to see protected owner details.

Ownership transfer and audit

Transfers require seller confirmation, acceptance by the named buyer, a cancellation window, and administrator approval. Titan uses a database transaction to keep the ownership update and certificate issuance consistent. The Laravel project has feature tests for blocked transfers, duplicate approvals, and rollback if certificate issuance fails.
